serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I ventured very far this time, I came all the way to the beach.
Shit! This place is full of plastic bags flying around and one just hit me right in the face!
That’s one of the reasons why this place is empty. Because of the air and sea currents this shore is always full of trash. Not an ideal tourist destination I would say.
There’s also the thing that this place is near that grounded ship…
I need to get going. The air is cold and sand is starting to enter the insides of my shoes.
Huh? That’s weird. I can see someone beside me here. What is she holding? No, that can’t be right. I will come closer just to make sure though…
No way, that older woman really is holding a fishing rod! Is she out of her mind? There’s no way there are fish swimming around in THIS water!
